stories.title: Meta releases its first frontier model, Muse Wonder
stories.summary: Meta launched Muse Wonder and Wonder Full, its first frontier-class AI models designed for complex agentic workflows, pricing top-tier subscriptions at up to $200 per month to diversify beyond ad revenue.
stories.why: Tests enterprise and consumer willingness to pay for frontier agent capabilities against OpenAI and Claude.

stories.title: AI startup Sarvam in talks for $300 million top-up; valuation may double to $3 billion
stories.summary: Indic AI startup Sarvam is in negotiations to raise a $300 million funding round that would double its valuation to $3 billion as sovereign AI investments accelerate across India.
stories.why: Signals fierce investor appetite for regional foundational models tailored to multilingual Indian enterprise workflows.

stories.title: Microsoft plans huge deployment of its own AI chips, with an eye on saving costs
stories.summary: Microsoft announced widespread deployment of its custom Maia 300 chip for cloud AI inference, aiming to slash operational expenses and reduce dependency on Nvidia GPUs.
stories.why: Hyperscaler silicon vertical integration directly lowers unit economics and inference costs for enterprise AI apps.

stories.title: Govt selects 19 fund managers under RDI, committing Rs 7,131 crore
stories.summary: India's government-backed Research, Development and Innovation Fund approved its first cohort of 19 fund managers, committing ₹7,131 crore to catalyze private capital into deeptech and emerging technologies.
stories.why: Expands institutional venture funding for Indian deeptech startups requiring patient capital and domestic R&D support.

stories.title: Microsoft president says UK is best placed to drive AI regulation
stories.summary: Microsoft President Brad Smith called for urgent global AI regulations, arguing AI currently faces less oversight than household appliances and advocating mandatory emergency kill switches for autonomous agents.
stories.why: Big Tech is proactively nudging policymakers toward standardized guardrails to preempt fragmented regional compliance hurdles.

stories.title: UK To Evaluate AI Models Before Release, Reversing Trump Policy
stories.summary: The UK government announced plans to independently test and evaluate frontier AI models prior to public release, reversing the self-regulatory direction favored by recent US policy.
stories.why: Product managers must budget for mandatory sovereign pre-deployment audits before launching agentic systems in Europe.

stories.title: SWI Group Raises €800 Million At €6.1 Billion Valuation To Expand AI Infrastructure And Compute Platform
stories.summary: European data center firm SWI Group raised €800 million at a €6.1 billion valuation to expand AI compute infrastructure and repurpose former FTX-linked Bitcoin mining sites into AI facilities.
stories.why: Crypto mining facilities offer turnkey power access, addressing the acute energy and grid bottlenecks in AI scaling.

stories.title: HCLTech Revenue Misses Estimates as AI Reshapes Indian IT Business Model
stories.summary: HCLTech reported an 11.5% revenue rise but missed analyst forecasts as enterprise clients pivot toward outcome-based AI models, even as net profit jumped 21.2% in the second quarter.
stories.why: Shows how generative AI adoption is pressuring legacy IT time-and-material contracts into productivity-based pricing.

stories.title: Agentic video startup Clueso raises $10M in Series A funding round
stories.summary: Clueso, an agentic video documentation platform founded by IIT Madras alumni, secured $10 million in Series A funding to expand enterprise sales and deepen automated video editing capabilities.
stories.why: Highlights strong global demand for vertical AI agents that automate enterprise product walkthroughs and onboarding videos.

stories.title: Trump administration plans to move AI testing agency officials to White House: The Information
stories.summary: The Trump administration plans to reassign senior officials from the federal AI testing and standards agency directly into the White House, consolidating presidential oversight over artificial intelligence policy.
stories.why: Centralizes AI executive authority in the White House, increasing political influence over national standards and security rules.

stories.title: Bain Capital Ventures Raises $1.6B for AI-Focused Early-Stage Fund
stories.summary: Bain Capital Ventures raised $1.6 billion across new funds targeting early-stage AI applications and technical infrastructure, demonstrating continued venture support for foundational innovations.
stories.why: Assures early-stage founders that dedicated multi-billion-dollar dry powder remains available despite macro tech caution.

stories.title: Salience Labs raises £94M to ease AI data centre power crunch
stories.summary: Photonic computing startup Salience Labs raised £94 million to scale optical interconnect technology, targeting the critical energy and bandwidth bottlenecks constraining modern AI clusters.
stories.why: Optical interconnects are emerging as high-margin infrastructure bets to bypass copper limits in gigawatt-scale data centers.

related.title: Veir Raises $110M in Series C Funding to Scale Superconducting Power Systems for AI Data Centers

stories.title: Scarlet raises $50M Series B to accelerate AI medical device certification
stories.summary: Regulatory tech startup Scarlet raised $50 million in Series B funding to accelerate automated compliance and certification processes for software-driven and AI-based medical devices.
stories.why: Healthtech PMs need automated compliance pipelines to significantly reduce FDA and CE regulatory clearance cycles.

stories.title: Former Plaud exec raises $26M for AI app that listens to you in the background
stories.summary: Mistlabs raised $26 million to launch Ambi, an ambient AI application that continuously listens in the background to provide real-time proactive context and cross-agent communication.
stories.why: Pushes product UX toward persistent, passive ambient monitoring, raising critical questions around user privacy and data security.

stories.title: Mesa School Bags ₹110 Cr To Launch New On-Campus Courses
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based Mesa School of Business raised ₹110 crore in Series A funding co-led by Dharana Capital and Elevation Capital to build an AI-first curriculum and launch campus programs.
stories.why: Reflects higher education's imperative to overhaul traditional business management curricula to train AI-literate leaders.
